svg.title: Model Training - Streaming Web Path and Persistence

g.text: Model Training - Streaming Web Path and Persistence
hbp: baseline + hbp; depre: baseline + psqi + depre;
age: all four categories. Minimum three complete visits.
Reject mixed sleep versions for depre / age.
method is passed through but train() always uses train_original().
RF: BP threshold defines binary target;
mood answer columns excluded from predictors.
Without the progress header, the view calls train() and logs within transaction.atomic().
Streaming worker does not wrap Fit + Activity in one transaction.
Filesystem writes are outside database transactions; later failures can leave artifacts.
This is an in-process thread, not a durable job queue; disconnect is not a cancel protocol.
